name: Control Centre
author: Jesse Chelin
description: One key, every daily system toggle: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, volume, brightness, night light, Do Not Disturb, stay awake, power profile, mic and media in a native Omarchy overlay

settings.note: Edited from the gear in the card header. Documented here for humans; the shell does not read this key. The keyboard shortcut is not stored here: it lives in one marked block in ~/.config/hypr/bindings.lua, which is where Hyprland reads it from.
settings.tiles: ordered array of { id, enabled }; the catalogue and each control's shipped default live in Model.js, and an id missing from this file takes that default
settings.barWidget: boolean, whether the launcher pill renders in the bar
settings.hintSeen: boolean, set once the first-run key hint has been dismissed
